sequence.title: The Sorcerer Takes Control
sequence.objective: Gojo's combat intelligence, Limitless, Blue, hand-to-hand and Red; contact is one-way; Thragg commits.
sequence.logic: Seq 2 ended with Thragg concluding that force alone is not enough. Seq 3 is Gojo's answer: for the first time he acts instead of waiting. Every exchange answers a question and sets up the next one. E1 (S3-01 to S3-03): can convergence pin a flyer? A Blue beside Thragg, not on him, turns the street into a debris storm. Thragg's efficient answer is a tangential burn, which holds him in place but leaves him blind behind a wall of debris. He learns the man can MOVE him; Gojo learns to use the blindness rather than the pull. E2 (S3-04 to S3-07): a second, tiny Blue self-pull through the wall puts Gojo unseen at Thragg's back. A palm with Blue at impact and a rising elbow land cleanly and barely matter: the hardest body Gojo has ever hit. Thragg's counter-grab produces the sequence's key image (S3-06): Gojo's hand holds Thragg's wrist while Thragg's other hand hangs 3 cm from Gojo's throat. Contact is one-way and chosen. Gojo uses Thragg's own thrust as the lever for a wrist throw, drives the Blue point down after him and releases it, burying him. Gojo lands between the heap and the lit city. E3 (S3-08 to S3-10): Thragg erupts unhurt, and every dangerous fragment hangs short of Gojo. A Six Eyes POV that rhymes with S1-06 shows the problem: the faint haze gives location but no intent, so Gojo reads the zero-wind-up hook late and dodges on Toji-trained instinct although Infinity would have held. Thragg's eyes catch the dodge. E4 (S3-11, S3-12): out of the pivot, a point-blank Red throws him east, away from the city, through three facades; his uniform is torn and his cape shredded. The wide shot shows the straight path, the slumped floors and the dust. Aftermath (S3-13 to S3-15): Thragg rises, wipes his split lip, smiles faintly: "Now we're fighting." He stops testing. Gojo stops clowning: the blindfold comes down to his neck, his hair falls loose, and he looks east with uncovered eyes, ready for a body that leaks no intent. Screen direction holds: Gojo left, Thragg right. Gojo's attacks travel left to right and Thragg's right to left. The only crossing is Gojo's straight self-pull into Thragg's airspace, and Gojo's descent west restores it. Real time throughout; no slow motion.
sequence.music_cue: 112 BPM (one beat is about 12.9 frames). Gojo's rising-fifth brass motif enters as a stinger at S3-01 f26 over a glassy synth arpeggio, swelling with the Blue (S3-02 f0). Brass stabs fall between Gojo's blows. The music thins to the arpeggio under the infinity_stop ring (S3-06). The groove drops out to a lone low pulse while the heap is still (S3-08 f24) and through the Six Eyes POV. A full-orchestra HIT lands on the Red release (S3-11 f6), and its tail rings over the collapse. Low brass plays Thragg's descending minor third as he rises. A HELD single low chord with the rhythm stopped (drop_out at S3-14 f34) sits under "Now we're fighting". Gojo's rising fifth swells in the strings as the blindfold comes down (S3-15 f28), handing off to Seq 4's 140 BPM taiko.

shots.prompt_core: Low-angle medium close-up of a tall, lean man with spiky white hair and a black cloth blindfold, in a black high-collared uniform, standing on empty air beside a bare traffic-light pole above a ruined intersection at storm-dark dusk. Warm orange rim light from the left outlines his hair and shoulder. His right hand rises to shoulder height, index and middle fingers extended, pointing up and to the right; a faint smirk. High in the soft-focus background on the right, a massive man in a white-and-crimson bodysuit and crimson cape hovers. Beside him, tower edges and cloud lines bow faintly toward an empty point, as if seen through warped glass. Static camera with a slight push-in.

tactical.intent: Gojo takes the initiative for the first time and tests whether convergence can pin a flyer.
tactical.read: Thragg, 30 m up, sees the gesture but has no frame of reference for it. He holds his hover.
tactical.outcome: The space beside Thragg starts to bend before he moves.
tactical.learned: Set-up. Gojo puts the point beside Thragg, not on him, so the whole street becomes the weapon.

shots.animation_notes: Gojo's hand moves on 2s, deliberate and precise. The fingers lock on f26 with no overshoot. The bend is a screen-space refraction warp whose radius grows from 0 to about 6% of frame width over f28-48, centred on the future Blue point. It has no colour and no glow. Thragg stays rock-still, because a Viltrumite hover does not bob; only his cape moves in the wind. Gojo's hair and blindfold tails move only with the ambient wind.

shots.action: f0-4: the bend collapses into a focal point: a small white-blue core, a ring of darkened, lensed space around it and a thin bright edge. The background pinches toward it. f4-14: the lightest matter moves first: dust and paper lift off the whole intersection and stream up toward the point in straight converging lines. f10-24: window glass follows, glittering. f18-34: chunks of the torn slab and asphalt peel up in the pull direction and accelerate. f26-44: the flattened lamp posts drag across the asphalt toward the point, then rip out of their bases at f36 and f40. f34-60: cars slide, tip onto two wheels and lift at f38, f44 and f50, slower and heavier than everything before them, and the fallen mast arm goes at f46. f40-72: everything that arrives compacts into a dense, churning mass about 6 m across around the core. Upper right, Thragg's cape snaps toward the point at f8 and his body tilts 10 degrees at f12 as the pull reaches him. Small at the left, Gojo does not move; his fingers stay raised.
shots.animatic_caption: Blue forms beside Thragg: dust first, then glass, slabs, lamp posts and cars stream straight into it.
shots.prompt_core: Extreme wide low-angle shot of a ruined city intersection at storm-dark dusk. In the sky beside a massive hovering man in a white-and-crimson bodysuit, whose crimson cape snaps sideways, a small white-blue core appears, ringed by darkened, lensed space and a thin bright edge; the skyline pinches toward it. Matter streams into it along straight converging lines: dust and paper first, then glittering window glass, then asphalt slabs peeling up, flattened lamp posts dragging across the asphalt and ripping free, and abandoned cars tipping and lifting. The heavier things move later and slower, compacting into a dense churning mass around the core. Far left, small, a white-haired man in black stands on empty air with two fingers raised. Warm sunset rim light from the left.

tactical.intent: Gojo: can convergence pin a flyer? A point beside Thragg turns the whole street into the weapon.
tactical.read: Thragg feels a pull with no source; his cape and body lean toward an empty point in the air.
tactical.outcome: The pull grabs him, and the street rises toward him.
tactical.learned: Gojo: the pull reaches Thragg at this range. The next question is whether Thragg can resist it.

shots.animation_notes: Debris on 1s, ordered by mass with fx.pull(mass=...): dust, then glass, then slabs, then lamp posts, then cars. Every object travels in a straight line toward the core, with no swirl. Objects accelerate as they near the core. Flattened lamp posts drag along the asphalt before they snap free. Cars slide and tip before they lift. The lensing ring is steady, with no pulsing. Gojo is a still silhouette; only his hair moves in the inflow.

The Blue is off the lower-left edge, and the debris flows toward it across the left of frame. Gojo, when glimpsed through a gap, is far screen-left and low.
shots.staging: Thragg starts at x=+11.5, y=29.5. The Blue point is at x=+7, y=22, 5 m north (upstage) of the fighters' plane. He burns tangentially, up and east at right angles to the pull, and slides along an arc around the point. Over f0-60 he is dragged to x=+11, y=25 and holds there, 7 m from the point, burning hard. Gojo is at x=-6, y=6 and visible for 4 frames (f50-53). Animatic: track Thragg, zoom 70 to 160.
shots.action: f0-6: Thragg tilts toward the point as the pull deepens; his cape streams toward it. f6-12: he reads the vector and turns his body away at right angles to the pull, like a ship escaping orbit. f12: a hard burn throws a vapour cone off his shoulders. f12-48: he is still dragged, sliding sideways and down along a curve around the point while he thrusts; the arc reads clearly against the skyline, and his boots and cape trail toward the point. At f18 a sedan tumbles past a metre from his face, at f27 a lamp post spears past behind him, and at f36 a slab cartwheels under his feet. Each one forces a small, precise correction: a roll, a hitch of the shoulders, a dip. f40-60: the stream thickens into a wall of cars, steel and concrete between him and the west, and he can no longer see Gojo. f50-53: a gap opens in the stream, and far down to the left Gojo stands on air, two fingers raised. At f54 the gap closes. f60-96: the camera pushes in to MCU. Thragg holds his position against the pull, jaw set, eyes moving, not panicked. Over f66-78 he glances at his own trailing hand, which is being drawn toward the point, then over f78-96 looks back west into the wall of debris. It is a realisation, not fear: this man can move him.
shots.animatic_caption: Thragg burns at right angles to the pull. He holds, but is dragged, and the debris wall blinds him.
shots.prompt_core: Tracking medium shot beside a massive man in a white-and-crimson bodysuit, with close-cropped black hair and a black mustache, flying hard at dusk thirty metres above a ruined street. His body angles away from an unseen pull, and a vapour cone ripples off his shoulders. His crimson cape and boots trail sideways toward a white-blue point of collapsing space just off frame-left. Debris tears past him in straight lines toward that point: a tumbling sedan inches from his face, a spearing lamp post, cartwheeling concrete slabs and glittering glass, walling off everything to the left. The camera pushes in to a close shot of his cold, analytical eyes glancing at his own trailing hand. Warm sunset rim light from the left, storm clouds above.

tactical.intent: Thragg: escape the pull without giving up his position or his line on Gojo.
tactical.read: Within a few frames he reads the pull's direction and burns at right angles to it rather than straight away from it. That is the efficient answer.
tactical.outcome: He holds 7 m from the point, but is dragged about 5 m and blinded by the wall of debris between him and Gojo.
tactical.learned: Thragg: this man can MOVE him, not only stop him. Gojo: Thragg can fight a moderate pull with thrust, so use the blindness instead.

shots.animation_notes: Thragg is on 1s for the burn and the corrections, and on 2s for the MCU acting. Every change of path follows the rule in 09: the body rotates first, then the trajectory follows. The drag must read as a curved slide around the point, not as hovering. Debris is on 1s, with light pieces faster than heavy ones. The cape is the clearest indicator of the pull vector, so keep it pointing at the Blue throughout. No camera shake: this is a smooth flying track.

A second, much smaller pinch of space flickers into being 1 m west of Thragg's back: a pin-prick of lensing with no core (a Blue self-pull, G1-19). f6-11: Gojo is yanked toward it along a dead-straight line, a white smear with a thin blue edge. Debris in the stream that would hit him decelerates a hand's width from his body, hangs for a frame, then resumes its path toward the Blue once he has passed. That leaves a clean, Gojo-shaped tunnel through the stream. f11: the pinch winks out, and he stops dead 1.2 m from Thragg's back, upright, hands loose. f12-28: the tunnel refills from its edges. Thragg, burning east with his head turned west into the debris, has not seen him.
shots.animatic_caption: Gojo pulls himself through the debris wall with a second, tiny Blue and stops dead at Thragg's back.
shots.prompt_core: Wide shot at dusk of a torrent of debris streaming in straight lines into a white-blue point of collapsing space above a ruined street. A tall white-haired man in a black blindfold and black high-collared uniform is yanked along a dead-straight diagonal through the stream toward a tiny pinch of warped space, his body a white smear with a thin blue edge. Shards and car parts in his path slow to a crawl a hand's width from him, hang, then fly on toward the point after he passes, leaving a clean tunnel through the debris. He stops dead, upright and relaxed, just behind a massive man in a white-and-crimson bodysuit who flies hard to the right, cape streaming. Warm rim light from the left.

tactical.intent: Gojo: use the blindness. Arrive where Thragg cannot see him coming.
tactical.read: Thragg is committed to his burn, with his head turned into a wall of debris; he cannot see the line Gojo travels.
tactical.outcome: Gojo arrives 1.2 m from Thragg's back, unseen.
tactical.learned: Thragg (in the next shot): the man can cross the gap in an instant, even through a wall.

shots.animation_notes: Gojo's travel is 5 frames on 1s with a smear. He stops without recoil or slide; there is no inertia, the pull simply ends. Debris near him uses fx.zeno for its last 0.15 m, then resumes along its original pull line. The second pinch is tiny and colourless except for a 1-pixel blue ring, and must not read as a second Blue orb.

For 3 frames the space around the palm dimples inward, a tight ring of air and dust sucked toward the contact point (Blue at impact). Thragg's torso gives perhaps 5 cm and stops, like a palm striking a bridge pier. f7-12 (recovery): Thragg feels it and starts to wrench round toward his right, head first. f13-19 (anticipation): Gojo steps through on the air, his right elbow rising inside. f20, CONTACT: the rising elbow meets Thragg's jaw as it comes round and turns it 30 degrees back the way it came, with another inward dimple. f21-30 (recovery): Thragg's head comes straight back to level, unhurt, and his eyes find Gojo for the first time. f30-54, a held reaction of 24 frames: Gojo opens and closes his left hand once at his side, as if testing it, and under the blindfold his smirk thins a fraction: it is the hardest body he has ever hit. Thragg, eyes on him, tilts his head very slightly.
shots.animatic_caption: Palm to the floating ribs, then an elbow that turns the jaw. Both land. Neither matters much.
shots.prompt_core: Side-on medium shot in mid-air at dusk, thirty metres above a ruined street. A tall white-haired man in a black blindfold and black high-collared uniform drives his left palm heel into the lower ribs of a massive man in a white-and-crimson bodysuit and crimson cape, from behind; the air around the palm dimples inward in a tight ring, sucking in dust. His rising right elbow then meets the big man's square, mustached jaw as he turns, twisting his head aside a few degrees. The head comes straight back, unhurt, cold dark eyes locking on the attacker, who flexes his hand once, his smirk thinning. Behind them, debris streams toward a glowing white-blue point at lower left. Warm rim light from the left.

tactical.intent: Gojo: test the body with two precise strikes to soft targets, each with Blue at impact.
tactical.read: Thragg does not see the palm coming, and he turns into the elbow.
tactical.outcome: Both blows land cleanly. Thragg's torso gives about 5 cm; his head turns 30 degrees and comes straight back. No injury.
tactical.learned: Gojo: this is the hardest body he has ever hit, so bare-handed blows will set up, not decide. Thragg: the man who cannot be touched can touch him.

shots.animation_notes: Gojo is on 1s for the strikes and on 2s for the hand-flex acting. Each strike has a 6-frame anticipation, a single contact frame and a 6-10-frame recovery. The light tier is deliberate: a small white star and six streaks, with no shake on the palm and a 3-px, 4-frame shake on the elbow. The Blue-at-impact dimple is an inward ring (radius 0.4 m collapsing to 0 over 3 frames), never an outward flash. Thragg's reaction is minimal: the less he moves, the harder his body reads.

shots.staging: Gojo is at x=+9.8, y=25, with his throat at y=26.5. Thragg is at x=+11.3, y=25. Thragg's right hand drives for Gojo's collar and is caught at x=+10.4. His left hand drives at Gojo's throat and stalls at x=+9.93, 3 cm short. Animatic: centre x=+10.3, y=26.2, zoom 420.
shots.action: f0-3 (anticipation): Thragg's right shoulder bunches. f4: his right hand flashes in for Gojo's collar, and in the same frame Gojo's left hand closes around the crimson-gloved wrist. That is CONTACT, and Gojo chose it: his pale fingers sink into the glove and the hand stops dead because Gojo is holding it. f6-9 (anticipation): Thragg's left hand loads instantly, the fingers forming a claw for the throat. f10-16: it drives in and decelerates: 80% of the distance in 2 frames, 15% more in 4, then a crawl. It hangs 3 cm short of Gojo's throat, and the grit and a sliver of glass carried with it hang in the gap, jittering. His left forearm and shoulder bunch as his body keeps pushing (infinity_stop at f12). f16-44, a hold of 28 frames: both hands in one frame, one held in Gojo's grip, the other unable to arrive. As focus racks to them at f22, Thragg's eyes flick from the gripped wrist to the hanging hand and back. He understands: he can touch me; I cannot touch him.
shots.animatic_caption: Gojo catches Thragg's wrist. Thragg's other hand hangs 3 cm from Gojo's throat. Contact is one-way.
shots.prompt_core: Tight close-up in mid-air at dusk between two fighters' chests. On the left, a pale long-fingered hand from a black uniform sleeve firmly grips a thick crimson-gloved wrist, fingers sinking into the glove. In the centre, the massive man's other crimson-gloved hand, clawed for a throat grab, hangs frozen three centimetres short of a black high collar, forearm and shoulder muscles bunched with effort. Fine grit and a sliver of glass hang suspended in the tiny gap, the background faintly refracted there like heat over glass. Upper right, in shallow focus, the cold dark eyes of a mustached face flick from one hand to the other. No glow, no shield. Warm rim light from the left.

tactical.intent: Thragg: grab the man who is touching him and finish this up close.
tactical.read: Gojo lets the right hand come and catches it by choice; the left hand is filtered by Infinity automatically.
tactical.outcome: The right wrist is held in Gojo's grip; the left hand decelerates and hangs 3 cm from his throat.
tactical.learned: Thragg: HE can touch ME; I cannot touch him. Contact is one-way, and it is Gojo's choice.

shots.prompt_core: Low-angle wide shot inside the shattered ground-floor lobby of a concrete office building at dusk, the floors slumped into a pile of broken slabs and rebar, dust pouring down through a punched hole above. A massive man rises steadily out of the rubble, slabs sliding off his shoulders and dust streaming from him. He has close-cropped black hair and a black mustache; his white-and-crimson bodysuit is torn open across the right shoulder and chest, the shredded remains of a crimson cape hang from one shoulder clasp, and a line of blood marks his split lip. He steps onto the crest of the rubble and turns his head to the left, cold eyes narrowing toward the far end of the tunnel. Warm rim light from the left through the dust.

tactical.intent: Thragg: get back up and re-acquire the target.
tactical.read: The tunnel is a straight sightline back to Gojo.
tactical.outcome: He stands, damaged but fully functional.
tactical.learned: Thragg: this man can hurt him.

shots.animation_notes: The rise is slow and unhurried, on 2s: the opposite of the eruption in S3-08, so the audience reads a change of temperature. The slabs slide off with weight, and the dust pours on 1s. Thragg keeps his chin level throughout. The torn shoulder and chest, the rag of a cape and the split lip must be legible here, because this is the injury reveal.

shots.action: f0-16: Thragg raises the back of his right glove and wipes the blood from the corner of his mouth in one slow stroke. f16-34: he lowers the hand and looks at the smear of blood on the crimson glove, a held beat of 18 frames; he has not seen his own blood in a long time. f34-40: his eyes rise west, toward Gojo. The contempt has gone; the look is focused, interested, because the dodge has registered. A faint smile lifts one corner of his mustache. f40-74: THRAGG, low, unhurried, almost pleased: "Now we're fighting." f74-80: he holds, the smile fading into focused aggression.
shots.animatic_caption: THRAGG wipes the blood from his mouth, looks at it, smiles faintly: "Now we're fighting."
shots.prompt_core: Slightly low-angle close-up of a severe, square-jawed man with close-cropped black hair and a thick black mustache, in a torn white-and-crimson bodysuit, standing in dusty rubble at dusk. He slowly wipes a line of blood from the corner of his split lip with the back of a crimson glove, then studies the red smear on the glove. His cold dark eyes lift toward the left, contempt gone, replaced by focused interest, and a faint smile lifts one corner of his mustache as he speaks quietly. Dust drifts through warm rim light from the left. The shredded remains of a crimson cape hang at his shoulder, and the torn uniform shows his right shoulder and chest.

tactical.read: He replays the dodge: the man flinched from a blow that could not reach him, so there is something to find.
tactical.learned: Thragg: the man who cannot be touched still dodges, so the barrier may not be everything.

shots.animation_notes: On 2s. The wipe is one slow, deliberate stroke with no flourish. The smile is minimal, one corner of the mouth under the mustache with the eyes unchanged, and it fades into flat intent. Lip-sync to the recorded line. The split lip stays visible after the wipe, and a fresh bead of blood returns at f52: the injury persists.

He needs his real eyes to read a body that leaks no intent.

shots.prompt_core: Medium close-up at dusk of a tall, pale man with snow-white hair in a black high-collared uniform, standing on a ruined street, in three-quarter view facing right. His smirk thins to a faint, contained curl at one corner of the mouth; his look turns slightly more serious. With two fingers he hooks the black cloth blindfold down off his eyes so that it hangs loosely around his neck, and his white hair, no longer held up, falls loose over his forehead. He looks to the right with uncovered, vivid, piercing bright-blue eyes, his long white lashes catching warm orange rim light from the left. Behind him at right, out of focus, dust pours from a punched tunnel through distant concrete buildings.

tactical.intent: Gojo: read a body that leaks no intent with the naked eye, since the Six Eyes through cloth gave only a late read (S3-09).
tactical.read: Thragg, 64 m away, has stopped testing; his smile says he is coming.
tactical.outcome: Gojo's eyes are uncovered, and he is slightly more serious.
tactical.learned: Gojo: Red moves him but does not break him. This is not a fight to clown through.

shots.animation_notes: On 2s. The blindfold comes down in one motion with two fingers, a rhyme with S1-07's lift, except that this time it does not go back up. The hair falls on 1s over 4 frames with a small settle. For the last 20 frames the eyes are the brightest value in the frame, but there is no glow and no aura. The change of expression is small: slightly more serious, not angry.
